verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack never documents a user-facing scheduler or recurring-workflow capability. The only recurrence mentioned is API hub's built-in metadata sync running every 6 hours. That is an internal default behavior of another feature, not a way for users to schedule their own jobs. General API, CLI, and Terraform automation docs are building blocks for one-off actions, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
